document.notes: THE ONLY SOURCE OF A CARRYFORWARD, AND OF A PRIOR-YEAR OVERPAYMENT APPLIED TO THIS YEAR. No information return reports either; if the prior return is absent the figures cannot be derived and must be asked for, and an absent carryover is not a zero carryover. ONE PIECE OF PAPER, ONE DOCUMENT: `prior-return` used to declare the same return again with five boxes spelled 'schedule d line 7' beside this document's 'schedule-d-16', and the two spellings were two owners of one question. The Schedule D boxes and their five routes were moved here and that declaration deleted. ITS BOX INVENTORY IS DERIVED, NOT HAND-KEPT: every carryforward's `prior_return_inputs` names the box that answers it, and the builder adds any this file does not already declare (`derived_from: carryforwards`). So a carryforward cannot be declared without the prior return gaining the box it needs — the discipline E17 applies to extraction, applied to reading. READ BY `custom.prior-year-1040` (spec 080 T086): `prebuilt-tax.us.1040` reads a CURRENT-year 1040 face and returns none of a prior year's schedule lines, so the prior return is read page by page against the boxes declared here — each box id names the 2024 form and line it is ('schedule d line 7' is 2024 Schedule D line 7, '36' is 2024 Form 1040 line 36), and every label is that form's own caption. A box the reader cannot find is an open question, never a zero. FR-019: every concept a prior-year rule or a carryover computation reads is declared here, each row `not_on_sheet` (prior-year input) naming the computation it feeds; the overpayment applied (box 36) is the one figure that places. Boxes are addressed by the PRIOR year's own line numbers. A prior return PRINTS ITS OWN NAME across the top of page 1, which is what the page classifier splits on.

extraction.note: No prebuilt model reads a PRIOR year's return: `prebuilt-tax.us.1040` reads a current-year 1040 face and returns none of the schedule lines a carryover reads. Read by the declared custom model over the boxes this document declares (spec 068 mechanism, spec 080 T086). NOT YET MEASURED on a real prior return. ONE section, not one per schedule: a custom section is keyed by its DOCUMENT and `section_for` matches a printed heading to the best section, so several sections of one document collapse to the first and every box outside it would fall to unattributed. The schedules are named in `instructions` instead.

custom.reads: a taxpayer's PRIOR-YEAR (2024) federal return — Form 1040 and the schedules and forms filed with it — for the carryovers and prior-year figures this year's return reads. Read only the lines listed; a schedule or form the packet does not include is absent, never zero.
instructions: Each box id names the 2024 form and line it is: '36', '1040 line 1a' and '1040 line 15' are lines of the 2024 Form 1040; 'schedule a line 17' is line 17 of the 2024 Schedule A; 'form 8606 line 14' is line 14 of the 2024 Form 8606. Report a figure under that id only from that form's own page.
